story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan loved pretending he was a superhero with a bright red cape. One Saturday morning, while his dad was fixing the car in the driveway, [emotion:QT/sad] Ethan noticed his little sister, Rosie, was crying near the front steps.

[emotion:QT/sad] Rosie had dropped her favorite toy truck into the tall, thick bushes beside the house. [emotion:QT/afraid] "I can't reach it," she said quietly. "It went too far inside.[gesture:think] "

Ethan thought carefully before he ran to the garage and grabbed a long, wooden stick. "If we both work together," he told Rosie, "we can reach it faster.[gesture:nodding-yes] " Rosie held the branches back while Ethan stretched the stick forward, slowly and patiently, until the red truck rolled free.

[emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:embrace] Rosie threw her arms around Ethan and laughed. Their dad had watched everything from the driveway. [emotion:QT/happy] "That was the most caring rescue mission I have ever seen," he said, [gesture:embrace] pulling them both into a warm, safe hug.

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt proud, because he had chosen to help someone he loved.
